title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Financial Management → Fund

source_objects.description: Workday Fund worktag. Used for fund accounting (GASB). Tracks restricted vs unrestricted, endowment, auxiliary, plant, agency.
Parent-child fund relationships for roll-up reporting.
Classification of funds (unrestricted, temporarily restricted, permanently restricted under pre-ASU 2016-14; with/without donor restrictions under ASU 2016-14).

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map: 'Without Donor Restrictions'→'unrestricted', 'With Donor Restrictions'→'restricted'. ASU 2016-14 terminology for FASB institutions. GASB institutions use fund-type-based restrictions.
Resolve parent fund ID for roll-up.
For public (GASB) institutions: 'current_unrestricted', 'current_restricted', 'loan', 'endowment', 'plant', 'agency'. Maps to GASB fund types for statement of net position.

notes: Fund accounting is critical for higher ed. Public institutions (GASB 34/35) report by fund type on the Statement of Net Position. Private institutions (FASB ASU 2016-14) report by restriction type (with/without donor restrictions). Workday supports both models through configurable fund worktags and hierarchies. The HELIX fund category taxonomy normalizes both GASB and FASB conventions.
